sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: International Tax Structuring and Transfer Pricing Advisory

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier (Articles L. 561-1 et seq.), Ordonnance n° 2017-563 du 19 avril 2017 transposing EU AMLD5, and Décret n° 2020-... establishing the Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Valid Passport or National Identity Card
Articles of Association and Incorporation Certificate

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against EU, French, OFAC SDN, UN, and domestic sanctions/PEP lists per AMF and ACPR guidelines

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Infogreffe RCS Portal (registre du commerce et des sociétés)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be in French language using Latin script with French diacritical marks where applicable; no foreign language names without French translation
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Names identical to existing registered companies
Protected words such as 'État', 'Armée', 'République', certain political or religious terms
Names that could mislead as to activity
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Administrative appeal to the Tribunal de Commerce or Ministry of Justice within 2 months of rejection; possible judicial review

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for registered office in France, provided a physical address for correspondence and mail receipt; virtual offices commonly accepted for administrative purposes
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low risk for standard pre-incorporation due diligence; unannounced inspections possible only upon suspicion of non-compliance or commercial substance requirements for specific tax regimes

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal due diligence and name clearance consultation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: International law firm specializing in French corporate law
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for cross-border structuring advisory

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO identification, profiling, and sanctions/PEP screening
Registered office setup and virtual office lease

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce) Articles L.210-1 to L.210-11, L.224-1 to L.224-3, and L.227-1 to L.227-20; Décret n°84-406 of 30 April 1984 on the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés; Décret n°2023-215 on the Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce de Paris, operating through the Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) and online RCS repositories.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de constitution de société (legacy CERFA form M0) filed electronically via the Guichet unique, together with the signed statuts and ancillary registration certificates.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No legal minimum capital for a SAS; the amount is freely fixed in the statutes. All cash contributions must be fully paid up and deposited with a licensed French bank or a notaire in a blocked account until the RCS registration delivers the Kbis extract.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, unanimously, in accordance with Article L.227-9 of the French Commercial Code, as follows: (1) the proposed French statutes of the Société par Actions Simplifiée are adopted; (2) 1,000 ordinary shares of €1 each are subscribed and fully paid-up by the shareholder, the capital being deposited into a blocked account opened with a licensed French bank pending registration; (3) the registered office is fixed at 12 Rue de la Paix, Paris 75002, France; (4) [Name] is appointed Président, authorized to act as legal representative with full corporate powers; (5) [Name] is appointed Directeur Général; and (6) the Président is directed to file the incorporation with the Guichet unique and to complete any statutory license registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and signing the SAS articles of association (statuts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Civil-law notary (Notaire) where required by contributions in kind or real property; otherwise private agreement among shareholders.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the French-language statuts under Code de commerce Articles L.227-1 to L.227-20, verify corporate name availability in the INPI/RCS database, fix the registered office and governance clauses, and have all shareholders execute the statuts in as many originals as required. If a contribution in kind is present, arrange notarial authentication and attachment of the contribution report.
required_dossiers: Identity document of each shareholder and officer
Certificate of corporate name availability search
Registered office lease or ownership proof
Criminal record extract for proposed officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe questions a statutory clause at a pre-filing stage, amend the relevant article, obtain fresh signatures, and re-notarize only the modified page if required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of share capital and obtaining the blocked-funds attestation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed French credit institution selected by the founders (e.g., BNP Paribas, Société Générale, La Banque Postale).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Wire the subscribed cash capital into a dedicated blocked deposit account opened in the name of the company in formation. Instruct the bank to issue an attestation de blocage des fonds setting out the exact amount, account holder, deposit date and release condition on presentation of the RCS Kbis extract.
required_dossiers: Shareholder identity documents and KYC forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses or delays the attestation on KYC/AML grounds, supplement the requested due diligence or move the deposit to another eligible bank or to a notaire acting as séquestre.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the legal formation notice in a journal d'annonces légales
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French legal gazette (Journal d'Annonces Légales) authorized in the seat of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the mandatory notice containing the corporate name, legal form, share capital, registered office address, corporate purpose, duration, names of signatories, and a number of copies. Obtain the attestation de parution upon publication.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the gazette requests corrections, the notice must be revised to match Code de commerce Article R.210-3 and re-published; the corrected attestation is then resubmitted with the formation application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic submission to the Guichet unique for RCS registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) transmitted to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce de Paris.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the electronic declaration (historical M0), attach all prescribed annexes, pay the official filing fee, and legally certify the submission by the elected electronic signature of a proxy or founder. The portal routes the file to the competent commercial registry for legal review and issuance of the Kbis extract.
required_dossiers: Registered office lease or occupancy title
Déclaration de bénéficiaires effectifs (beneficial owner declaration)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe or the Guichet raises a query, respond with corrected documents within 15 days through the same portal. A refusal may be cured by filing a regularization declaration and resubmitting the annexes without losing legal priority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration tax, social security and employer declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) and URSSAF Paris.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Kbis is issued, retrieve the SIREN/SIRET identifiers and confirm the VAT registration via the impots.gouv.fr portal. Make the necessary corporate income tax elections and register the company as an employer for payroll, occupational medicine and apprenticeship contribution purposes if staff are hired.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VAT number is not issued automatically within four weeks, send a formal escalation letter with the Kbis to the competent Service des Impôts des Entreprises. URSSAF non-issuance is cured by presenting the Kbis and payroll registration form.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial and environmental licensing clearance and workplace compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Préfecture de Police de Paris (fire safety), DREAL Île-de-France (environmental exemption if challenged), and the URSSAF occupational health service.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Classify the physical office as an administrative consultancy premises. Verify that no ICPE authorization or environmental impact assessment is required; obtain a fire safety certificate for the premises if open to the public (ERP type 5), an electrical conformity certificate, an accessibility verification certificate, and make the workplace declaration to the occupational health service.
required_dossiers: Fire extinguisher maintenance contract and commissioning certificate
Accessibility and structural load inspection certificate, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the fire service rejects the certificate, execute corrective works within the notice period and schedule a new visit. If an environmental objection arises, file a formal exemption declaration under Code de l'environnement Article L.511-1 confirming that the activity is a low-risk administrative service.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: DREAL Île-de-France (environmental) and Chambre de Commerce et d'Industrie de Paris - Île-de-France (business licensing interface); no sectoral industrial board applies to an international tax advisory consultancy.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Extrait Kbis issued by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce as the official right-to-operate certificate for the SAS; no additional classified industrial operating permit is required for a pure consultancy under the ICPE regime.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) Île-de-France
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - pure consultancy and administrative office; not listed under the French Classified Installations for Environmental Protection (ICPE) regime and no environmental impact assessment report is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Only ordinary office wastewater is generated and is discharged to the sanitary sewer in full compliance with Code de la Santé Publique Articles R.1331-1 et seq.; no production processes produce VOCs or process emissions; waste is segregated and disposed of in line with Code de l'environnement Article L.541-21-2, including certified operator collection of electronic and hazardous waste.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification for the registered office if open to the public (ERP type 5) issued after a visit by the commission de sécurité; structural load inspection confirming floor capacity for office occupancy; electrical installation conformity certificate (NF C 15-100 or Consuel); workplace clearance preventing occupational hazards and access for emergency services, together with the declaration to the occupational health service and the longitudinal health monitoring programme.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via the official portal at impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French entities including SAS must register with INSEE to obtain a SIREN number, followed by mandatory registration with the tax authorities to secure a VAT identification number (FR followed by SIREN). Foreign-owned entities adhere to identical procedures upon incorporation or acquisition in France.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections exist; SAS entities may instead elect specific regimes such as the parent-subsidiary holding company treatment under Article 223 A of the Code Général des Impôts or other optional corporate tax elections.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-facturation for all taxable transactions above the registration threshold, requiring real-time transmission to the French tax authorities and digital time-stamping via the official platform.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT applies to exports of goods and offshore services upon proof of actual export or non-domestic service delivery, substantiated by customs documentation and evidence of foreign performance.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Non-compliant or fraudulent zero-rating claims trigger penalties of up to 5% of the VAT amount, interest charges, retrospective clawback of benefits, and potential criminal liability.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France maintains a regime of free convertibility for both current and capital accounts pursuant to EU single market rules and OECD commitments. Profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are permitted without prior approval or surrender, subject only to standard tax filing obligations and ongoing AML/CFT verification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds are not subject to mandatory surrender or conversion requirements. Exporters may retain foreign currency receipts in dedicated accounts. All export transactions remain subject to mandatory customs declaration formalities and statistical reporting to INSEE for aggregate data purposes.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasible for regulated electronic money institutions licensed by the ACPR under MiCA and PSD2 frameworks; offshore EMIs must maintain full French AML/CFT compliance and may face operational restrictions on certain cross-border payment corridors.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote corporate onboarding is fully permitted via digital identity verification platforms and video KYC interviews; in-person director interviews are required only for new accounts or heightened risk cases.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions screening adverse hit or PEP exposure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source of funds and wealth certificates, beneficial ownership declarations, and legal opinions confirming compliance with EU and French sanctions lists

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership structure opacity or unreconciled corporate filings
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized ownership chain extracts, updated RCS extracts, and independent verification reports

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital injections routed via SWIFT MT103 or SEPA Instant for EU transfers, employing purpose codes including 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION', 'EQUITY INJECTION', or 'SHARE CAPITAL'. All transactions require board resolutions, incorporation certificates, and source-of-funds verification.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements cleared through SWIFT MT103 wire transfers or issuance of commercial letters of credit via correspondent banking networks. Settlements must reference trade contracts, commercial invoices, and export customs declarations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (liasse fiscale) — forms 2065/2033-B
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFIP) — Service des Impôts des Entreprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months after fiscal year-end; for a 31 December year-end, electronic filing is generally accepted until early May by DGFIP schedule. Extension available only on timely request to the tax inspector.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing invokes a 10% late-filing penalty (5% if regularized within 30 days of the statutory deadline), monthly late-payment interest at 0.20% under CGI Art. 1727, and forced assessment if the return remains omitted after two formal notices.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory accounts (balance sheet, profit and loss account, annexes) deposited with the Commercial and Companies Register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Registre National du Commerce (INPI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than 7 months after fiscal year-end: shareholder approval of accounts within 6 months of year-end, and registration of accounts within 1 month of approval. A court order may extend the approval period in exceptional circumstances.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure or late filing subjects the company to court-ordered filing injunctions and a civil fine up to EUR 15,000; repeated non-filing for two consecutive fiscal years may authorize the commercial court to order dissolution; the company may also be formally reported as non-compliant in the public register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation and update of beneficial-owner declaration (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs) for the RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / INPI (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No fixed annual calendar date; declaration must be filed within 30 days after any change in the identity, share percentage, or control rights of beneficial owners. The company must ensure the declaration remains accurate at each annual accounts filing window.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate or untimely UBO declaration carries criminal and civil penalties: up to EUR 7,500 for natural persons and EUR 15,000 for legal entities, plus possible closure of the company's register standing and delays in issuance of certificates of compliance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A French SAS must appoint a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) if, at the closing of the fiscal year, it exceeds two of the three following thresholds: total balance-sheet assets above EUR 4,000,000; net turnover excluding VAT above EUR 8,000,000; average permanent workforce above 50 employees. Mandatory appointment also arises when the SAS controls or is controlled by an entity that itself exceeds those thresholds or when a minority shareholder formally requests an audit under Article L224-3-1 C.com.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Individual statutory accounts must be prepared under French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général, following Directive 2013/34/EU). Consolidated accounts, if applicable, may apply IFRS as adopted by the European Union.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France does not impose a separate annual UBO declaration. The company is legally bound to maintain the accuracy of its beneficial-owner declaration filed with the RCS; any transfer of shares or any change in ultimate ownership, control chain, or voting rights must be reported to the greffe within 30 days. During each annual accounts filing cycle, the company should reconcile its internal shareholders register and UBO information to avoid a stale public record.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 216–864 (EUR 200–800) per year for commercial domiciliation or registered-office agent services, excluding physical office lease costs
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500–10,000 for a typical advisory SAS engagement, rising materially if the entity exceeds audit thresholds or is part of a cross-border consolidated group

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (standard rate; reduced 15% on first €42,500 of taxable profit for SMEs)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Research Tax Credit (CIR) up to 30% of eligible R&D expenses; Innovation Tax Credit (CII) for SMEs; reduced rate for small profits; territoriality for foreign branches

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2065 (income tax return) and 2065-SD (annex) filed via EFI (Échange de Formulaires Informatisé) or e-filing portal impots.gouv.fr
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Generally May 3rd for fiscal year ending December 31; extended to May 15 if filed electronically; for non-calendar year-end, within 3 months of year-end

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report French-source income only; apply treaty provisions if applicable
Losses from French permanent establishment may be carried forward subject to limitations
Include CIR, CII, and other credits; attach supporting documentation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Withholding tax on dividends and other distributions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare gross distributions and claim treaty relief via Form 5001
Disclose any adjustments made to align with arm's length principle

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 5% of tax due, plus 0.5% per month of delay, capped at 10% of tax due; additional 10% for failure to file after formal notice; interest on late payment at 0.2% per month

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 30% (12.8% income tax + 17.2% social contributions) for non-residents, unless reduced by tax treaty
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim treaty relief, submit Form 7 (residence certificate) and Form 5001 (application for reduced withholding) to the French tax authorities before filing; TRC from home country must be attached; approval typically takes 2-3 months
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory 33.33% (often reduced to 0% under EU Interest & Royalties Directive if treaty applies); Interest: statutory 30% (often reduced to 0% under EU directive or treaty)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Full documentation (Master File and Local File) required if group revenue > €400 million or balance sheet > €400 million; simplified documentation for smaller entities
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France applies anti-abuse rules (e.g., substance-over-form, GAAR) but no specific ESR; however, for tax structuring, substance must be demonstrated to avoid sham transaction allegations

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of income, false documentation, or concealment of assets
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fine up to €500,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years; civil penalty of 80% of evaded tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable for unpaid taxes if they participated in fraudulent acts; travel bans and asset freezes possible

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Lack of economic substance, no real business activity, or artificial arrangements to avoid tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reclassification of transactions, denial of treaty benefits, penalty of 40% of tax understated
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may face civil restitution and disqualification from managing companies; criminal charges for abuse of law

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to implement AML procedures, suspicious transaction reporting, or due diligence for high-risk clients
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fine up to €5 million or 5% of turnover; criminal penalties for money laundering up to 5 years imprisonment
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be held criminally liable for AML breaches; personal fines and imprisonment; travel bans may be imposed
